PREMIUM-SIGNED PCR AS AN S4 EVIDENCE-QUALITY OVERLAY -- PROPOSE FOR /calibration-audit, DO NOT HAND-PATCH. HOG's contract-count PCR (5.37, 84.1st-pctl OI-PCR) reads a put-heavy crowd; net_put_premium is negative (puts net sold, $11,791) and the whole book is ~$0.34/contract -- the crowd the validated S4 spec would fade does not exist on a dollars-at-risk basis. This is the same class of problem the 07-27 PFGC denominator-floor fix addressed (a contract-count metric that doesn't reflect real positioning) but on the premium-sign axis instead of the volume-floor axis. Recommend testing a premium-sign corroboration requirement (net_put_premium > 0) as a candidate S4 pre-condition, gated through scripts/retro_harness.py --all before it binds any live decision.
